issues.on_page: Other Local Receipts 709,699 = General 47,726 + Activities Fund 392,547 + School Nutrition 269,426
issues.issue: Activities Fund receipts are 392,547 of 709,699 (55%), more than half of the line. Under the rules, school activity fund receipts are Extracurricular Receipts, and a broad line takes the category that makes up more than half of it. Charges for services/fees is only for genuine service fees.

This line is food sales (a la carte / non-reimbursable meals), not a reimbursement, so the category should be School Lunch Sales. The extraction's own detail_category already says school lunch sales, so the two fields disagree.
The statement prints this under Support Services - Other. Treating it as capital outlay is the extractor's own judgment. It includes 2900 General Supplies 39,402 (p7), which may not be capital.
Supplies bought from the Depreciation Fund are recorded as capital outlay. This can be defended, but it is a judgment call.
These look like sponsor contributions and could be donations/contributions. The extractor already marked the line for review.
